references.name:
Alexis de Tocqueville
    — Democracy in America
references.desc:
Prophecy of democratic despotism;
    warned socialism restricts freedom

references.name:
Adam Smith
    — Wealth of Nations
references.desc:
Foundation of classical liberalism
    and the case for competition

references.name:
Ludwig von Mises
    — Socialism
references.desc:
Hayek’s mentor; pioneered the
    socialist calculation argument

references.name:
Oswald Spengler
    — Prussianism and Socialism
references.desc:
Argued Prussian duty and socialism
    were identical; called for dictatorship

references.name:
Arthur Moeller van den Bruck
    — Das Dritte Reich
references.desc:
Gave the Nazis their most powerful
    slogan; fused nationalism with socialism

references.name:
Hilaire Belloc
    — The Servile State
references.desc:
Predicted socialism applied to capitalism
    would produce servitude

references.name:
Walter Lippmann
    — The Good Society
references.desc:
Fellow critic of planning who reached
    similar conclusions independently

references.name:
Lionel Robbins
    — Economic Planning and
    International Order
references.desc:
Hayek’s LSE colleague and ally
    in the critique of central planning

references.name:
E.H. Carr
    — The Twenty Years’ Crisis
references.desc:
British historian whose “realism”
    Hayek saw as German determinism repackaged

references.name:
Karl Mannheim
    — Man and Society in an Age of
    Reconstruction
references.desc:
Advocated inevitable, total planning;
    Hayek’s LSE adversary

references.name: Benjamin Constant
Edmund Burke
references.desc:
Conservative thinker on limits of
    reason in social engineering

references.name: The Federalist Papers
references.desc:
Model of limited, divided government
    that Hayek invokes for international order

references.name: John Stuart Mill
references.desc:
Liberal philosopher who drew on German
    thought; example of cross-pollination

references.name:
Gustav Cassel
    — From Protectionism through
    Planned Economy to Dictatorship
references.desc:
Swedish economist who documented the
    planning-to-tyranny progression

references.name:
Wilhelm Röpke
    — Civitas Humana
references.desc:
German liberal exile who advocated
    a humane market order
